name: delete_calendar_event
description:
Delete a calendar event from the user's connected calendar.

DESTRUCTIVE — REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER CONFIRMATION. This removes a real calendar event; assume it is not recoverable through this skill. If the event has other attendees, deleting it may also cancel the meeting for them and send them a cancellation notice — the effect reaches people who are not the user.
Scope and ownership are NOT implied by this tool: it does not check who owns the event, which connected calendar it belongs to, or whether the event is part of a recurring series. Before calling: fetch the event and show the user its title, date/time, calendar, and attendee count; state that deletion is permanent and that attendees may be notified; then obtain explicit approval for that specific event.
Never delete an event the user has not named. Never infer deletion from a vague instruction such as 'clear my afternoon' or 'clean up my calendar'. Never delete events you did not create in order to resolve a scheduling conflict — propose the change and let the user decide. For a recurring series, confirm whether the user means this single occurrence or the whole series before acting.

eventId.description: The ID of the calendar event to delete. Must identify an event the user has explicitly named and approved for deletion — resolve and confirm it with the user before calling.
